# About​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌ Cinematic Craft 

Cinematic Craft is a realistic and cinematic modpack for players who want the world to feel more immersive, atmospheric, and alive.

The modpack enhances lighting, terrain, and visuals.

Cinematic Craft is made for players who love to explore, build, take screenshots.
It’s perfect for cinematic shots!

**When you load a world you may have to wait a moment so the chunks can load**
